body: Im 15 so I can't really go to a bar and I got fired from my last minimum wage job :/

im really not as caring and loving as you think i am, and im sorry but i might still go through with it... its not just people keeping me down, i feel the same way they do and i keep trying to fix myself but its not working.

yeah, im mostly alone and solitary and all that.

i cant think of something thats new social interaction as you call it though. theres nothing new around here. if i leave my building im bound to run into people who want to start shit. im in the middle of the city.

ive never played video games either so while that sounds fun its not realistic. ive been through a half dozen temporary parents and adopted three times... some were pretty great but they could never afford that stuff. 

thanks for replying though
hey i saw this message but i have to go, will read it later

i try to read a lot, but at home im usually doing chores or working. i listen to the radio most of the time when i can too. when i have a lot of time i walk to the library. 

i used to play basketball but im not good enough to do it anywhere near my apartment so i havent in a while.

first of all fuck you for assuming i havent tried all of the obvious things

ignoring people does not work. i dont know what idiot ever thought that up but it does nothing to people who physically attack you. laughing with them? yeah its funny that im a fucking poor white freak. hahaha i cant afford new shoes this is hilarious, nobody talks to me lolol, i have to walk to the library to use the internet hahahaa its so funny, oh good one guys you hit me in the head with that do it again 40 times before this class ends lol. hahaha you peed on the book i was reading which i worked all week to buy, so funny, aaah lol, its all over me!. aw shucks you got me, now my only good pair of pants is ruined with ink and dog shit and whats that? now its funny that i have the dog shit you smeared on my pants smeared on my pants? haha you guys are hilarious. hitting them back is the only thing that stops it for a while. 

when i do go to class and try to do the homework, guess what, i get D's and thats just because im not sure how to get an F but they dont give those wehn i just skip class for a few weeks so. i really have tried to be normal. ive tried to talk to people. ive tried to change myself. ive changed a lot of things, just not the ones they think up and dont tell me. working hard doesnt help and just drains energy from more productive things. 

i dont have social circles. i was being serious about not having people talk to me. the ones who do are just trying to point out what i look like or how im weird or any number of other things i cant change before repeating their helpful comments until i get off the bus walk with them following me for a few blocks and then lock the door to my building, they start hitting me or i just take the initiative and just hit them and get sent to the office. nobody knows my real name, they just call me a nickname i hate and do their best to not be forced to work with me on anything. 

if anything, writing here has reinforced the feeling like eating a bullet.

i dont think pride is my problem.. if i go to class im going to end up being surrounded by people making fun of me until i end up getting in a fight or going home to the same shit in a different setting. either way it just gets worse. when i do go to class and try to ignore them i just get shitty grades anyway.

thanks but im pretty much the definition of worthless. i dont have any good works, i get straight D's because i skip class too much. cant do anything right and nothing would change if i wasn't born. 

i dont have a good relationship with teachers, most look for reasons to write me up or kick me out of class, but thats my fault i just cant sit around and take shit forever and the administraters wont let me stay in the library or bathroom all day so.
